question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**remarkable**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The context emphasizes the extraordinary nature of the subject being described.
 
• The word "remarkable" conveys something that is worthy of attention or extraordinary, which aligns well with the context.
 
• The other options like "fancy", "sober", and "elevated" do not convey the intended meaning effectively in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• Fancy (शानदार): While "fancy" may suggest something elaborate or decorative, it does not fit the intended meaning of extraordinary or noteworthy here.
 
• Sober (गंभीर): "Sober" refers to seriousness or moderation, which is not relevant in this context.
 
• Elevated (उन्नत): "Elevated" means raised or lofty but does not align well with the context.
